description: Judged the twelvemonth short, and closed the errand.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Asked for the corner, left the bargain, and did not touch the nail.
name: Hamnet Shakespeare

description: Left the opinion for him to carry back, and brought the bread.
name: Joan Shakespeare

description: Gave tomorrow morning, and kept the sword out of the form.
name: John Shakespeare

description: Put the ribbons under the same rule, and kept hers.
name: Judith Shakespeare

description: Counted three shirts, and kept the trade out of it.
name: Mary Shakespeare

description: Asked whether anyone married, and whether a second play followed.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Told the opinion and the ending, and promised to report Anne's sentence word for word.
name: William Shakespeare
